claims.claim: One of the best book for psychiatry
claims.evidence: The report only shows the book cover text (“PSYCHOLOGY”, “Shorter Oxford Textbook of Psychology”, “Seventh Edition”) and does not verify the seller’s opinion or any psychiatry-specific content.

risks.risk: Condition may be poor (heavy cover wear, spine damage, page tears) which affects resale value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of the spine and corners plus a photo of several pages showing any tears/loose pages.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used book with unknown condition (worst-case: possible wear/defects) until condition is confirmed.

risks.risk: Completeness is unknown (missing pages or missing accompanying materials).
risks.proof: A photo showing the table of contents and a quick flip-through clip/pages count (e.g., show page numbers at start and near the end).

risks.risk: Authenticity/edition details may be unclear (printing/ISBN not readable), risking a counterfeit or wrong edition.
risks.proof: A photo of the copyright page showing publisher, year, and ISBN/printing details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified authenticity (worst-case: treat as not confirmed correct edition).

risks.risk: Internal markings (highlighting, notes, stamps) can reduce value.
risks.proof: A photo of 2–3 interior pages showing whether there is highlighting/pen/pencil/stamps.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there may be markings (worst-case: assume noticeable writing).

risks.risk: Format/size (paperback vs hardback) and exact physical dimensions may not be clear from the cover alone.
risks.proof: A side-angle photo showing thickness and whether it’s paperback or hardback, plus a quick measurement reference (e.g., ruler/hand span).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for the less-preferred format until confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the spine and back cover (wear/creases).
Send a photo of the copyright/ISBN page to confirm authenticity and exact edition.
Send a photo of the table of contents and the first/last pages (to confirm completeness).
Send 2–3 interior page photos showing whether there is highlighting/notes/stamps.
Confirm whether it is paperback or hardback and show thickness/side view.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as an Oxford “Shorter Oxford Textbook of Psychology (Seventh Edition)” from the cover text, so it can be priced at worst-case used-book assumptions while condition/authenticity/completeness remain unverified.
